players.product: memory (DRAM / NAND) and display-driver assembly & test

quarterly_data.signal: ChipMOS May 2026 unaudited consolidated revenue was NT$2,384.3 million (US$76.0 million), down 3.1% from April 2026 (NT$2,460.5 million) and up 17.7% from May 2025 (NT$2,025.4 million). The company said it continues to benefit from ongoing revenue strength led by a persistent AI-related demand/supply imbalance; while it has been investing in footprint expansion, new capacity is being used to meet existing customer forecasts and long-term supply agreements.
